name: com.leuconoe.litert-lm-unity
description: On-device AI for Android in Unity: LLM chat, speech recognition, image understanding and function calling through a native LiteRT-LM v0.14.0 bridge. Includes a dual-mode VAD, live microphone capture with endpointing, and a Windows editor fallback for pre-device verification. No network required at runtime.

samples.description: Interactive scenes: LLM chat, ASR (file / microphone / always-listening), multimodal image+audio, voice and multimodal function calling, and translation. Includes the shared UI kit and the scene generator.
Batchmode smoke tests, the conversation regression test and the 20-case function-calling benchmark, plus the Android APK build menu. Depends on the Test Scenes sample.
